capacity.scope: one loaded-profile scale-1 request; not concurrent 1M admission

limitations: One serving boot per arm; six within-run throughput windows are not independent boots.
Fixed-shape activation changes can change data-dependent expert routing.
Scale-4 C4 throughput is 2.61% below official in this workload; scale-1 warm C4 TTFT p90 remains elevated.
Kernel microbenchmarks are isolated warm replay observations, not a whole-model speed guarantee.

fixed_shape_grid.summary: median per shape of the per-replay slowest rank; eleven shapes; correlated distributed ranks, not independent samples; row preparation excluded; data-dependent expert routes can change

raw_json_storage: Original API, cold-request and receipt JSON bytes are gzip-compressed; compressed-raw-files.json records both SHA values. This keeps the million input token IDs out of the review diff without dropping observations.
